title: Restricted coefficient maps on a natural indexed injective roof
statement: Let v:Z→X, φ:F→v_*G, and injective resolutions I of F and J of G be given. Let L be a nonnegative complex of injectives on X, ell:v_*J→L a quasi-isomorphism, and beta:I→L with Iota_I beta=φ v_*(Iota_J) ell in degree zero. For U open in X, let R and R-prime be the prescribed restricted resolutions on U and v inverse U [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]. Write a_I,a_J for the usual classical-to-resolution-section comparisons followed by R.sections and R-prime.sections [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]; use ell and beta without extension. Then moduleCohomologyFMap(v restricted to U, restrictedDirectImageMap φ,q);a_J;H^q Γ(U,ell) equals a_I;H^q Γ(U,beta). This involves one scheme morphism and no total derived functor.

source.place: Tags 01E4 and 01FB: restriction of resolutions and the cohomology roof formula

proof.text: Restrict L to U. Exact open restriction preserves injectives. The restriction/direct-image pullback isomorphism, and the prescribed comparison of J on v inverse U, give a local denominator into L restricted to U. Restrict beta and use both augmentation equations and naturality of the pullback isomorphism to verify its coefficient augmentation.

Use these arrows and the canonical top-section comparison as ModuleCohomologyFMapData. Its denominator induces isomorphisms on sections because it is a quasi-isomorphism from a direct image of injectives to injectives. The independence theorem permits this choice.

The degreewise restriction-adjunction computation and R.components identify the numerator and denominator with sections on U of beta and ell. Postcompose the data-map formula and cancel the inverse denominator.

theorem restrictedCoefficient_natRoof {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (v : Z ⟶ X)
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Z.Modules) (φ : F ⟶ (pushforward v).obj G)
    (I : InjectiveResolution F) (J : InjectiveResolution G)
    (L : CochainComplex X.Modules ℕ) (hL : ∀ n : ℕ, Injective (L.X n))
    (ell : ((pushforward v).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex ⟶ L)
    (hell : QuasiIso ell) (beta : I.cocomplex ⟶ L)
    (hbeta : I.ι.f 0 ≫ beta.f 0 = φ ≫ (pushforward v).map (J.ι.f 0) ≫ ell.f 0)
    (U : X.Opens) (R : RestrictedResolutionSections I U)
    (R' : RestrictedResolutionSections J (v ⁻¹ᵁ U)) (q : ℕ) :
    letI := RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor_additive U.toScheme.toRingedSpace
    letI := RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor_additive (v ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.toRingedSpace
    let Γ := (RingedSpace.openModuleSections X.toRingedSpace U).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
    let H := HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (ComplexShape.up ℕ) q
    let rI := (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapIso
      ((show InjectiveResolution (C := SheafOfModules.{u}
          (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) ((restrictFunctor U.ι).obj F) from
          R.resolution).isoRightDerivedObj
        (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor U.toScheme.toRingedSpace) q) ≪≫
      (((RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex R.resolution).sc q).mapHomologyIso
        (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{u})).symm
    let rJ := (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapIso
      ((show InjectiveResolution (C := SheafOfModules.{u}
          (moduleRings (v ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            ((restrictFunctor (v ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj G) from R'.resolution).isoRightDerivedObj
        (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor (v ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.toRingedSpace) q) ≪≫
      (((RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex R'.resolution).sc q).mapHomologyIso
        (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{u})).symm
    moduleCohomologyFMap (v.resLE U (v ⁻¹ᵁ U) le_rfl)
      (restrictedDirectImageMap v φ U) q ≫ rJ.hom ≫ H.map R'.sections.hom ≫ H.map (Γ.map ell) =
      rI.hom ≫ H.map R.sections.hom ≫ H.map (Γ.map beta)
